related_questions.question: How much cash assistance will I get in NH?

text_blocks.snippet: In New Hampshire, the amount of cash assistance a family receives through the Financial Assistance to Needy Families (FANF) program, formerly known as TANF, depends on their income, resources, and living arrangements. For a family of three, the maximum monthly benefit can be $1,291, which is roughly 60% of the Federal Poverty Level (FPL). This amount is subject to adjustments as the cost of living changes.
snippet_highlighted_words: For a family of three, the maximum monthly benefit can be $1,291

list.title: FANF Program:
list.snippet: New Hampshire's FANF program provides cash assistance to needy families with dependent children.

list.title: Eligibility:
list.snippet: Families are eligible for FANF if their income and resources are within established limits, and if the dependent children lack parental support or care due to death, absence, or disability.

list.title: Income Limits:
list.snippet: A family of three can receive cash assistance as long as their gross monthly income does not exceed $1,291 (60% of the FPL), according to NCCP.org.

list.title: Benefit Amounts:
list.snippet: The specific amount of assistance varies based on individual circumstances, but the state has mandated that the maximum monthly benefit for a family of three should be 60% of the FPL, according to NCCP.org.

list.title: Time Limits:
list.snippet: FANF benefits are temporary, with a lifetime limit of 60 months.

list.title: Other Services:
list.snippet: FANF also provides other assistance, such as medical assistance, home heating fuel deliveries, and rental security deposits.

related_questions.question: What is the NH State Health Insurance Assistance Program?

text_blocks.snippet: The State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) in New Hampshire provides free, one-on-one counseling and assistance to Medicare beneficiaries and their families regarding Medicare and other health insurance options. SHIP aims to help individuals understand their coverage, make informed decisions, and know their rights and protections.
snippet_highlighted_words: provides free, one-on-one counseling and assistance to Medicare beneficiaries and their families regarding Medicare and other health insurance options

list.title: Provides free, unbiased counseling:
list.snippet: SHIP counselors offer personalized, one-on-one guidance on Medicare and other health insurance matters.

list.title: Helps with Medicare enrollment:
list.snippet: SHIP can assist with understanding Medicare enrollment, plan choices, and benefits.

list.title: Explains different coverage options:
list.snippet: SHIP can help individuals understand their Medicare options, including Original Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and Medicare Part D prescription drug plans.

list.title: Assists with appeals and grievances:
list.snippet: If you have issues with your Medicare coverage, SHIP can provide support with the appeals and grievance process.

list.title: Educates the public:
list.snippet: SHIP also offers public education presentations and materials about Medicare.
Find a local SHIP counselor: You can locate a SHIP counselor near you by using the SHIP Locator tool on the State Health Insurance Assistance Programs website.
Contact your local Area Agency on Aging: Many SHIP services are offered through local Area Agencies on Aging.
Visit the NH Medicare Counseling website: You can find more information and resources about SHIP on the NH Medicare Counseling website.
